responsibility: Implements bidirectional conversion between the Rust frontend lexer’s Token objects and the libproc_macro_internal token model used for procedural macros. This file owns the translation of literal kinds and numeric suffixes, identifier and punctuation reconstruction, delimiter/group nesting into TokenStream and Group nodes, span/location conversion, and the reverse path back through re-lexing or token constructors, making it the bridge between frontend parsing tokens and proc-macro token streams.
same_name_distinction: Implementation file for the rust-token-converter pair: it performs the actual two-way translation between frontend Token vectors and libproc_macro_internal TokenStream/TokenTree objects, including literal suffix handling, punctuation grouping, delimiter nesting, and re-lexing. rust-token-converter.h only declares those conversion entry points.
